leaf_cases.note: 历史复用：已核对 retained-go-20261025/part-052 与 included-continuation-final-20261027#/leaf_cases/427 的结论，保留其原始记录，不把旧草稿当本轮通过。历史候选 Travelmint 本轮复核仍无许可证文件/授权声明，且未取得能证明供应商净价、客户应收/供应商应付双向账务的正文，故未收录。本轮补采：destinationlab 官方 DMC 页明确写有供应商合同/费率/服务库、按日行程自动成本与加价、确认预订后的供应商确认与执行，以及多币种供应商付款和客户开票；Voyant 官方首页与平台文档明确面向 DMC，覆盖供应商实时库存、带价行程/报价、预订与供应商确认、客户收款/退款、供应商发票匹配与财务核对。两者按商业基本记录收录，未做价格、架构、部署或运行核验。开源补证未成立（不等于产品不存在）：检索索引曾摘要显示 voyant-travel/voyant 为 Apache-2.0 完整 OSS 平台，但 2026-10-29 直接抓取该仓库页、README、LICENSE 均为 HTTP 404，GitHub API 返回 403 限流，无法用官方快照核验仓库身份与许可证；csm-workflows-tool 无 LICENSE/授权声明；iTourTMS 为要求 license key 的专有许可；sanxinkeji/travel-quote-system 虽为 MIT，但只覆盖历史报价库、行程规划与报价导出，缺供应商库存商业条款、确认预订和双向账务；MooNsConfig 只能访问 fork（原仓库 404），其 README 未证明供应商应付，fork 身份也不适合作正式开源案例。r24k 官方页可证明报价、合同费率、毛利、确认预订和供应商确认，但未出现客户开票/供应商付款等双向资金记录，未纳入。
leaf_cases.service_boundary: 本叶核心是 DMC 运营方的供应商服务库存（含采购净价/佣金等商业条款）、按成本加价的行程/报价、与供应商落实的确认预订，以及客户应收/供应商应付的双向资金记录。仅行程规划、报价文档、CRM、市场分销或供应商寻源不纳入；本次两条商业记录均只按官方正文证明基本用途和核心匹配，未核验价格、架构、部署或实际运行。

fetch_outcomes: Historical GitHub API metadata for Travelmint showed license null/NOASSERTION and last push 2016; current repository page has no license file or license statement, and README only describes DMC costing/itinerary/quotation/booking capabilities without two-sided money evidence.

https://github.com/voyant-travel/voyant and its main README/LICENSE returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-29; api.github.com/repos/voyant-travel/voyant returned HTTP 403 rate limit exceeded. The index summary claiming Apache-2.0 could not be confirmed from official snapshots.
ba-ramirez-tech/csm-workflows-tool is a public full-stack DMC workflow app but its repository page and README contain no LICENSE file or license grant, so it was not treated as open source.
mg-gouda/iTourTMS LICENSE is a proprietary software license requiring a license key, not an OSI-approved open-source license.

sanxinkeji/travel-quote-system is MIT licensed, but its README covers a historical quotation library, itinerary planning, pricing and export only; supplier inventory terms, confirmed bookings and two-sided money are not evidenced.

MFA-G/moonsconfig is a fork; schowdary75/moonsconfig returned HTTP 404. The fork carries an MIT LICENSE and README claims supplier RFQs, net cost/margin, quotes, bookings, payments and invoices, but supplier payables are not evidenced and the fork identity is not suitable as the official upstream case.

r24k.com/dmc-travel-software official page shows quotation building from contracted rates, margins, confirmed bookings and supplier confirmation tracking, but no client invoicing, supplier payments, receivables or payables; omitted as boundary evidence only.
destinationlab /en/dmc-software first exceeded the 1 MB fetch limit; refetched with 3 MB limit and saved as an official documentation snapshot.
Official homepage/documentation snapshots for Voyant and destinationlab were saved and reviewed; these support the two commercial basic records but not an open-source claim.
